name: shapedplugin/shaped-kit
description: Connects AI agents to ShapedPlugin products through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

scripts-descriptions.tools:install: Install the isolated PHPUnit and PHPCS toolchains under tools/.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the loader scripts, the unit suite and the integration suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:scripts: Run the dependency-free loader tests (fresh PHP process per scenario).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the PHPUnit unit suite (no WordPress).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the WordPress-backed suite; skips cleanly if the WP test library is absent.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check WordPress coding standards and PHP 7.4 compatibility.
